newsitem.title: USA: Dennis Rodman steals the gold at Sotheby's auction.
newsitem.headline: Dennis Rodman steals the gold at Sotheby's auction.

text.p: Chicago Bulls basketball star Dennis Rodman paid a record $827,500 for a gold coin which was originally designed for President Theodore Roosevelt on Monday night at a Sotheby's auction.
But the "Saint-Gaudens" 1907 Ultra Relief Double Eagle coin failed to fetch an expected $1-$1.2 million.
The coin, designed by Augustus Saint-Gaudens, is one of 18 coins in a set of what is considered to be the most beautiful of all United States coins.
"Sotheby's is proud to have been able to offer such a rare and important collection of coins, particularly the Saint-Gaudens Double Eagle," said Paul Song, Sotheby's coin specialist in New York.
